verdict.rationale: The Trusted Agent Protocol is published openly with a reference implementation, but the agent-registry, merchant, CDN-proxy and agent components are all Visa's own code. The MCP server and toolkit are Visa-maintained as well. No evidence names any independent third party, let alone two, that implements the protocol or platform. An open spec and vendor-built samples do not by themselves show an ecosystem.

support.subject: As a developer, at least two independent parties beyond the vendor implement the protocol or platform — it is an ecosystem, not a private integration
